blocks.title: A Truly Global Business Education from Mumbai to London
blocks.band: ATLAS X The London School of Economics and Political Science.

blocks.heading: Academic Experience with Global Perspective
blocks.text:
Start your undergraduate journey at ATLAS ISME and enjoy the opportunity to gain a truly global academic experience with The London School of Economics and Political Science.

Complete the first two years in Mumbai, building strong foundations in business, academic depth and industry perspective. Apply to study abroad at LSE in your third year, through The General Course, where you can choose from a wide range of disciplines and experience a rigorous international curriculum in London.

On completion, receive an official LSE transcript alongside your degree from ATLAS SkillTech University, adding global academic recognition to your profile.

Designed to meet international academic standards, this integrated learning experience ensures curriculum continuity, global exposure and strong career readiness, preparing you for higher education and global career opportunities.

blocks.title: About The London School of Economics and Political Science
blocks.text: The London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE) is a world-leading university renowned for its academic rigour, interdisciplinary research and global outlook. Situated in the heart of London and recognised as one of the top institutions in the United Kingdom and internationally, LSE combines formal academic study with opportunities for real-world engagement, LSE graduates are widely respected for their analytical expertise, professional readiness and capacity to lead in complex international environments.
